quotes.text: LLM's handle cognition. Executors handle operations. Mixing those is how you get chaos. The model can propose a plan. It cannot guarantee that the email was sent, the file was saved or the permission existed.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Separates reasoning from execution, the core idea of the episode.

quotes.text: If an action can be retried, it needs a key that makes the second attempt a no-op or a consistent override. Timeouts prevent zombie calls.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A concrete rule for safe retries in agent tool calls.

quotes.text: Essentially, the graph is the constitution. The executor is law enforcement. The LLM is counsel, not judge.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable metaphor for the roles in a governed agent architecture.

quotes.text: The truth, graph validation, outperforms chaos engineering because it prevents classes of incidents rather than documenting their fallout.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear thesis on prevention over post-incident testing.

quotes.text: If you can't open a run and see exactly which node inflated tokens or stalled latency, you don't have observability, you have vibes with timestamps.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sharp definition of what real observability for agents means.

takeaways: Let the model propose plans, but let a policy-bound executor run tools with preconditions, idempotency keys and verified post-conditions.
Encode workflows as validated graphs with explicit contracts, allow lists, compensations and human checkpoints so agents fail safely.
A pre-execution check of capability, permission and feasibility, plus tracing tied to metrics, improves accuracy, latency, cost and auditability.
hook: Prompt-only AI agents hallucinate tools, skip preconditions and declare victory on partial failures. This episode is for architects and builders of agents on Microsoft 365, Microsoft Graph, Azure OpenAI and Copilot Studio. Learn how executors, validated workflow graphs and a pre-execution contract check make agents reliable, secure and auditable.
